notes: Desired mod set. tools/fetch-mods.mjs resolves real files, hashes and dependencies into manifest/locked-mods.json. side: both|client|server. enabled:false = candidate recorded but not installed by default.

mods.name: Railcraft Reborn
mods.notes: Custom license: public modpacks allowed (no sale, link GitHub, release builds only). Layer: inter-base rail logistics between BC/IE in-base transport and AE2/Ad Astra.

mods.name: Ad-Astra: Giselle Addon
mods.notes: Ad Astra QoL/compat layer (MIT). Audit which automation conveniences fit stage rules; must not bypass oxygen/fuel/rocket tiers.

mods.name: Ad Astra: Asteroid Belt
mods.notes: CurseForge-only; brand-new small project (verify jar license). High-risk mining dimension; keep the miss-landing/rocket-loss mechanic.

mods.name: Simple Structures: Ad Astra
mods.notes: Datapack-style structure mod (MIT); upstream declares client optional. Must coexist with Ad Astra: More Structures — audit density/loot overlap.

mods.name: TACZ Turrets
mods.notes: 中后期军用自动防御：炮塔实体装入任意 TaCZ 枪，从相邻/下方容器取弹（最后一公里由物流填箱）。MIT。内置 Registrate/GeckoLib/SmartBrainLib jarJar。需要 tacz >=1.1.8-hotfix-r6（即本包的非官方移植版）。

mods.name: TaCZ Addon
mods.notes: 枪匠台/附件管理 QoL（GPL-3.0-only, Mafuyu404）：按枪过滤附件与弹药、材料跳转 JEI、批量合成、邻近容器取料（含 Sophisticated Backpacks）。只降操作负担，不降制造成本——不得用它绕过阶段或材料。

mods.name: TaCZ Pack Upgrader
mods.notes: MUKSC (LGPL-3.0-or-later)。仅服务于非官方 TaCZ 1.21.1 移植：启动时自动把 tacz/ 目录下的旧格式枪包（如 EOS 枪包的 forge: 标签配方）升级为移植版可读格式。只负责格式兼容，不授予枪包素材再分发权。

mods.name: Almost Unified
mods.notes: 材料统一层（ARR，manifest URL 分发）：把 c: 标签内同名材料的配方输出统一为指定优先 Mod 的物品，减少重复锭/板/粉/块。

mods.name: Applied Cooking
mods.notes: AE2↔Cooking for Blockheads 桥（MIT）：Kitchen Station 让烹饪台直接读 ME 库存。

mods.name: Applied Delight
mods.notes: AE2↔Farmer's Delight 桥（MIT）：ME Cooking Pot 从 ME 取食材，仍需真实热源。

mods.name: Starforge Compatibility
mods.notes: 本仓源码构建的小型行为兼容层（MIT，tools/build-compat.mjs 确定性产出）：electric_burner 电能厨房热源（FE 能力 + FD 原生热源语义）与 horde_alarm 怪潮红石警报（HordeStart/EndEvent 驱动，SavedData 登记）。

mods.name: Macaw's Furniture
mods.notes: Living/decoration layer for bases, industry, stations, colonies. ARR — distributed via manifest URL like Easy Villagers; recipes audited against unified materials.

mods.name: Framework
mods.notes: MrCrayfish library — hard dependency of Refurbished ([0.13.10,) per its neoforge.mods.toml). LGPLv2.1.

mods.name: MrCrayfish's Furniture Mod: Refurbished
mods.notes: Modern furniture + native electricity network + Computer (Paddle Ball/Home Control/Marketplace/Coin Miner). Code MIT, assets ARR — manifest-URL distribution only. Requires Framework; stoves are natively in farmersdelight:heat_sources.

mods.name: Energized Furniture
mods.notes: FE→Refurbished bridge: EnergyTransformerBlockEntity extends RF ElectricityGeneratorBlockEntity (native source node) and exposes Capabilities.EnergyStorage.BLOCK. ARR — manifest-URL distribution only. Runtime dep on refurbished_furniture (undeclared in jar metadata).

mods.name: Engineers Delight
mods.notes: modid tmted. Native IE×FD machine recipes (Squeezer/Mixer/Bottling/Metal Press/Garden Cloche) — do NOT duplicate in KubeJS. License discrepancy: jar says MIT, Modrinth project says MPL-2.0 (Modrinth wins for distribution metadata).

mods.name: Immersive Cooking & Farming
mods.notes: MIT. IE multiblock food automation (Cookpot/FoodFermenter/FoodProcessor) + FD recipe converter. Requires IE + Vinery (see below). Beta — dedicated-server multiblock stability is a tracked acceptance item.

mods.name: [Let's Do] Vinery
mods.notes: Effectively required by Immersive Cooking & Farming: its mods.toml uses legacy `mandatory=false`, which NeoForge ignores — every dependency entry defaults to required. Vinery 1.5.3 (not 1.5.4, too fresh) satisfies [1.5.3,); its only dep, Architectury API, is already locked.

mods.name: Creature Feature
mods.notes: Replaces Phenominae: rare anomaly/special-mechanic hostile creatures.

mods.name: Arachnids
mods.notes: Swarm/area-threat bug enemies (Starship Troopers style); gated off early planets via In Control.

mods.name: Guard Villagers TACZ Support
mods.notes: Jar ships GuardVillagersTACZSupportClient + IllagerModelMixin — client copy required for gun-in-hands rendering of armed guards/illagers.

mods.name: Artifacts
mods.notes: Curios-backed curio items (13.x: curios/cloth/architectury optional upstream, we ship curios). Default chest/mimic injection kept but re-tiered via Starforge GLM pools; natural-drop balance audited in docs.

mods.name: JEI
mods.notes: ftb-xmod-compat requires jei >= 19.53.0.425; newest release channel was older.

mods.name: Carry On
mods.notes: Optional candidate per docs/compatibility.md; requires blacklist config before enabling.

mods.name: EMI
mods.notes: Default recipe/item viewer. Built-in JEMI layer imports JEI plugins as recipe sources — JEI stays installed for its API/plugin surface (ftb-xmod-compat, BC CE, IC2CRE). JEI 19.57 has no persisted overlay toggle: overlay is hidden per-session via Ctrl+O (key.jei.toggleOverlay); verified by bytecode (ClientToggleState is in-memory only).

mods.name: Inventory Profiles Next
mods.notes: Requires libIPN + Kotlin for Forge. Inventory sorting/refill; GUI buttons stay, extra hotkeys unbound via pack/config/inventoryprofilesnext/inventoryprofiles.json (libIPN hotkey config, not vanilla keybindings).

mods.name: Xaero's Minimap
mods.notes: ARR; Modrinth CDN redistribution allowed. Server-side install is the official optional feature (world identification + enforced profiles). Fair-play restriction of radar/cave mode via pack/config/xaero/*/server_profiles/default.cfg (default_enforced_profile).

mods.name: Xaero's World Map
mods.notes: ARR; pairs with minimap for per-dimension map data + waypoints.

mods.name: Shulker Box Tooltip
mods.notes: Compact tooltip by default; full contents behind Shift (config preview mode).

mods.name: BetterF3
mods.notes: Requires Cloth Config. Default modules trimmed to FPS/coords/biome/chunk/mem/GPU/Java/dimension.

mods.name: Better Ping Display
mods.notes: Numeric ping in tab list; client-only, no keybinds.

mods.name: Chat Heads
mods.notes: Player heads in chat; client-only, no keybinds.

mods.name: 3D Skin Layers
mods.notes: tr7zw protective license permits modpack redistribution via official mirrors.

mods.name: CustomSkinLoader
mods.notes: GPL-3.0; Universal 15.x bootstrap jar, loaders=[fabric,forge,neoforge,quilt]. Must coexist with 3D Skin Layers — verify skin pipeline on real client.

mods.name: Default Options
mods.notes: First-install default keybinds/options delivery (config/defaultoptions/*). Requires Balm. Keeps existing players' options.txt untouched on pack updates.

mods.name: I18nUpdateMod
mods.notes: CFPAOrg 自动汉化更新 (AGPL-3.0-only, github.com/xfl03/I18nUpdateMod3). Client-only: downloads the community zh_cn mod-translation resource pack and applies it when the game language is zh_cn — other languages unaffected. Loads via ModLauncher ITransformationService — the -all.jar intentionally has no mods.toml (jar-deps reports 'no mods.toml'; expected). Covers third-party mod translations only; Starforge's own text stays in localization/ + kubejs/assets (different namespaces, no overlap). Distributed via mrpack URL like every mod; no jar shipped.

mods.name: Iris
mods.notes: Shader loader for the default shader pack. Sodium 0.8 line requires Iris >=1.8.13; on 1.21.1 NeoForge only the 1.8.14 beta satisfies that (latest stable Iris 1.8.12 pins Sodium 0.6.13, which Supplementaries 3.9.9 declares incompatible [0,0.8.12-beta.1) — a hard mod-loading block, so no all-stable combo exists in this pack). Pin prefix 1.8.14 so a future stable 1.8.14+ release is picked automatically.

mods.name: Lithium
mods.notes: Official CaffeineMC NeoForge build exists for 1.21.1 (0.15.4+mc1.21.1, neoforge jar). Enable only after the full-instance A/B in docs/performance.md passes: IC2CRE/BC/IE/AE2 machine ticks, Railcraft trains, Ad Astra chunkgen, Guard Villagers + TACZ combat, horde events.

mods.name: Async Locator Refined
mods.notes: MIT; maintained port of bright_spark's AsyncLocator (Alvaro842DEV) for 1.21.1 NeoForge. Moves /locate, treasure-map and dolphin structure searches off the main thread. First new-perf candidate to test: no gameplay-logic change; verify locate correctness vs Structure Layout Optimizer + Ad Astra structures before enabling.

mods.name: BadOptimizations
mods.notes: MIT; 2.2.2 exists for 1.21.1 NeoForge. Client-only tick overhead: lightmap-update caching, sky-color sampling, idle debug renderers. Test alongside Sodium+Iris+ImmediatelyFast for visual glitches before enabling.

mods.name: Alternate Current
mods.notes: Rewrites redstone dust update order (non-locational) — a REAL BEHAVIOR CHANGE, not a pure optimization. Only consider if spark shows redstone dust as a top hotspot in large IE/BC bases; must re-verify AE2/IE/BC/Railcraft wiring, Horde Alarm signalling and all redstone contraptions. Skip entirely otherwise.

mods.name: ScalableLux
mods.notes: Starlight-based light-engine replacement with optional parallel light updates. 1.21.1 NeoForge exists only as alpha/devbuilds — no stable release. Candidate solely for a proven chunk-gen/light hotspot; do not stack with other lighting rewrites.

mods.name: Noisiumed
mods.notes: GPL-3.0-only; Noisium fork (imbavirus) with a 1.21.1 NeoForge build (3.0.2). Chunk-generation fast paths claiming identical world output. Overlaps Fast Noise in purpose — do not stack blindly; A/B both, and verify same-seed worldgen parity incl. Ad Astra dimensions before any adoption.

mods.name: Fast Noise
mods.notes: modid zfastnoise (ZenXArch, MPL-2.0). Vanilla worldgen noise optimization; declared incompatible with moonrise/antixray (not installed). Must verify identical worldgen across Ad Astra dimensions (same seed, on/off).

mods.name: Structure Layout Optimizer
mods.notes: TelepathicGrunt, MIT. Requires resourceful-config (installed). Speeds up structure/jigsaw layout checks incl. Ad Astra planets; verify structure spawning unchanged.

mods.name: AllTheLeaks (Memory Leak Fix)
mods.notes: CurseForge-only. Fixes known mod/MC/NeoForge memory leaks; respects upstream version guards — do not force-enable guarded fixes. Watch overlap with ModernFix.

mods.name: Mem Leak Fix GPU
mods.notes: alchemyyy, MIT (github.com/alchemyyy/MemLeakFixGPU). Client-only; releases stale RenderTarget GL ids on a delayed client-tick queue (no forced GC). Verify no texture loss/black screens alongside Sodium+ImmediatelyFast; demote to candidate on any render anomaly.

mods.name: libIPN
mods.notes: Required by Inventory Profiles Next.

mods.name: Kotlin for Forge
mods.notes: Required by Inventory Profiles Next / libIPN (client-side only).

mods.name: Cloth Config API
mods.notes: Required by BetterF3; optional for Chat Heads.

mods.name: Curios API
mods.notes: Curio slot framework (LGPL-3.0-or-later). Hosts Artifacts items and Sophisticated Backpacks' native back slot; no extra slot-framework mods.

resources.name: MakeUp - Ultra Fast
resources.notes: Default shader (LGPL-3.0-or-later). Non-mod resource: lands in shaderpacks/ via .mrpack files[] download, never inside mods/ and never on the server. Default-on via pack/config/iris.properties + official profile=low preset (pack/shaderpacks/<file>.txt).

resources.name: EOS – Dawn Goddess Lab (TaCZ Gun Pack)
resources.notes: EOS – Dawn Goddess Lab，All Rights Reserved — 只经 CurseForge CDN manifest URL 分发，zip 永不入库或嵌入包内。中后期重型/科幻武器层：落入 tacz/ 目录（双端），由 tacz_pack_upgrader 在启动时升级为 1.21.1 移植版格式（forge:→c: 标签转换）。含 26 把高斯/电浆/特种枪械（eos 命名空间）、8 种弹药与约 50 种配件；EOS 配方经 recipe_filters 路由到自带工作台 eos:eos_printer（tacz:workbench_b + BlockId），另有 eos_old 换肤转换台。
